author: JerryRigEverything
description:
Samsung has been holding out on us. Watertight phones CAN have removable batteries. You know what else you can hold? Water Tight Jerrycans are just 3 bucks for a pack of 12! Use code: THIRSTY at https://www.DrinkBison.com And thank you for supporting the channel and helping me clear space at the factory for bigger machines!

The Samsung Galaxy Xcover7 Pro is built to be a corporately rugged work phone. And has the price tag to prove it.  Personally I think a regular phone and a case would perform just as good if not better/ since the cameras and charging speed on this guy are.... not great. 

Would you buy the Xcover7 pro? current pricing is here: https://amzn.to/4yJYCX2
